rows.title: Quest stages, flags, globals shared
rows.proves: SetStage on the host reaches the guest, shared hash equal

rows.title: Globals shared
rows.proves: a changed world global reaches the guest

rows.title: Effects captured at the VM, typed events
rows.proves: every write of a shared domain is reported (no uncovered writes)
rows.note: host bridge counts uncovered writes; needs a scenario that asserts zero

rows.title: Guest runs no quest or reference scripts
rows.proves: SetStage on a guest changes nothing and is counted as suppressed

rows.title: Topics and notes shared
rows.proves: AddTopic and AddNote reach guests

rows.title: Map markers and reveals shared
rows.proves: a discovered marker unlocks fast travel on every peer

rows.title: Karma and faction reputation shared
rows.proves: fame, infamy and karma are one value for the party

rows.title: Faction membership, relations, crime flags
rows.proves: faction changes and crime flags replicate

rows.title: Perks routed by kind
rows.proves: an initiator or recruiter perk goes to one player, a shared perk to all
rows.note: decision checked per quest row; delivery to the right player's rows needs perks::add to take a recipient

rows.title: Per-player quests via player shadow
rows.proves: a per-player quest moves only that player's row and never the shared hash

rows.title: Per-player quest variables reach their owner
rows.proves: a script variable the host sets for player N appears in N's own live rows, shared hashes equal

rows.title: Per-player shadow swap around host script runs
rows.proves: a host script run for player N reads and writes N's rows

rows.title: Party-aware conditions
rows.proves: GetDistance min, GetInCell, GetItemCount any, IsKiller any evaluate over the party

rows.title: Mutually exclusive outcomes, first commit wins
rows.proves: the second final battle is refused once Caesar's, House's or the Independent one began

rows.title: Irreversible forks by party vote
rows.proves: majority decides, the host breaks a tie
rows.note: hooks that raise the vote from message boxes are missing

rows.title: 487-quest rules table loads
rows.proves: the bundled policy validates and has 487 rows

rows.title: Policy ids match the load order
rows.proves: every row is keyed by its quest's id in the full load order
rows.note: DLC rows are stored under their own load index

rows.title: Rewards once per player
rows.proves: RewardAll, quest items and initiator pay land exactly once per player per policy

rows.title: Kill XP, karma and kill attribution to the killer
rows.proves: a guest's kill pays the guest XP and karma

rows.title: Friendly-fire guard on named NPCs
rows.proves: deliberate hits on guarded NPCs by a guest trigger the row's rule

rows.title: Endings and the final battle
rows.proves: an ending commits for the whole party and locks the rivals
